args: how do I make a landing page
stdout:
Build kit for "how do I make a landing page"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The closest template; none is exactly this page. Scaffold it, then replace its content. Keep its layout and spacing.

name:        centered-hero
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Symmetrical centered stack (headline, short blurb, paired call-to-action buttons) resting on one wide full-bleed picture, with nothing on either flank competing.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template centered-hero --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        table-grouped
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template table-grouped --type page <path>

name:        ai-chat-landing
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Zero-state entry surface centered on a single composer with suggestion chips instead of history, sized for the moment before any content exists.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template ai-chat-landing --type page <path>

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        AppShellTopNavOnly
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Simple layout with TopNav and no side navigation, suitable for landing pages.

name:        AppShellWithBanner
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Full layout with TopNav, SideNav, and a dismissable info banner between the nav and content.

name:        useOverlayHookUsage
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A product card that is its own overlay container: useOverlay returns the ref and props to spread on the Card and a...

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        Banner
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Banner shows a persistent message at the top of a page or section.
